Table 1. Null GWAS simulation: LD fit

Excess Gaussian LD-fit loss (ridge 0.001) of each single panel over the mixed panel at the generating weight, per SNP; lower is better, and the mixed panel is 0 by definition. Chromosome 22, fixed 250 kb LD blocks. Each setting is a GWAS combining two ancestries' discovery samples at the stated composition; PRS-MIX uses the matching weight. PRS-CS with automatic φ. Means over replicates with Monte Carlo standard errors in parentheses; within a replicate every method analyses the same simulated GWAS and scores the same target individuals. The seed rerun repeats first-ancestry PRS-CS with a different sampler seed and measures run-to-run variation.

Table 4. PRS-MIX against the seed rerun and the single panels

Replicate-paired comparisons at the generating weight. Overlap and correlation are differences from the seed rerun (both first measured against first-ancestry PRS-CS); negative values mean PRS-MIX changes scores more than a new sampler seed alone. Null score variance is PRS-MIX relative to the seed rerun (geometric-mean percentage change). The last two columns are PRS-MIX's r2 minus single-panel PRS-CS's; positive values favour PRS-MIX. pp, percentage points. Chromosome 22, fixed 250 kb LD blocks. Each setting is a GWAS combining two ancestries' discovery samples at the stated composition; PRS-MIX uses the matching weight. PRS-CS with automatic φ. Means over replicates with Monte Carlo standard errors in parentheses; within a replicate every method analyses the same simulated GWAS and scores the same target individuals. The seed rerun repeats first-ancestry PRS-CS with a different sampler seed and measures run-to-run variation.

Figure. Per-replicate differences across the sweep

Each point is one replicate (simulated GWAS), with a violin for the distribution and a box for the median and quartiles; dashed line at zero. a, PRS-MIX minus the seed rerun in top-10% overlap with first-ancestry PRS-CS (negative: PRS-MIX changes the top decile more than a new sampler seed). b, PRS-MIX minus first-ancestry PRS-CS in r2 with the true genetic value (positive: PRS-MIX more accurate). At most 100 replicates per setting (see the tables for each count).

Generated from inst/scripts/results/sim250_sweep_100rep by inst/scripts/null_sim/13_sweep_summary.R (at most 100 replicates per setting; the Replicates column gives each setting's count) at PRS-MIX c81e720. Every number is in sweep_tables.tsv.
